_doc: Classic Era hand-entered Paladin effects for calibration.

Consecration.note: AoE Holy damage over 8s: the tank's AoE threat (+20% threat), leveling +3% (mana permitting), AoE +10%. PvP (2026-09-27): medium, stealth: Holy damage on the ground breaks stealth on rogues and druids who walk in (flag rooms, sap guards), kills totems and pressures groups; the holy-heal model counts none of its damage. Holy tier 3.

Improved Lay on Hands.note: Armor on the LoH target and shorter cooldown: utility. PvP (2026-09-27): low, defensive: Lay on Hands every 40 min instead of 60 and +30% item armor for 2 min on the target: still at most one full-health save per battleground. Audit said medium; lowered for the 40 min cooldown.

Unyielding Faith.note: +5%/rank fear/disorient resist. PvP (2026-09-27): medium, resist: +10% chance to resist fears and disorients (Fear, Psychic Scream, Intimidating Shout, Scatter Shot). Audit said high; a 10% resist chance is a nice extra (Forever's 30% shorter duration is high).

Illumination.note: 20%/rank chance for a full mana refund on crit heals (100% at 5/5): refund = chance x crit (22%) -> +4.4%/rank mana.

Divine Favor.note: Guaranteed crit heal every 2 min. PvP (2026-09-27): high, burst: Guaranteed crit on the next Holy Shock, Flash of Light or Holy Light, 2 min cooldown: the crit Holy Shock burst or an emergency crit heal; the holy-heal model has no damage sources. Needs Illumination 5/5.

Holy Shock.note: Instant heal/damage every 30s (Classic): +2% healing, +4% Holy damage leveling. PvP (2026-09-27): high, burst: Instant Holy damage or heal on a 30 s cooldown: the shockadin's uninterruptible finisher and heal on the move. The holy-heal model counts only its small healing share. Holy 31 points.

Improved Devotion Aura.note: +5%/rank Devotion Aura armor (rank 7: 735 -> 919 at 5/5): ~+1.4% armor on a tank -> ~0.3%/rank effective health, and the whole melee group gets it (raid utility 0.4%/rank). Wowhead: 'Devotion Aura is the most commonly used aura for tanking, so it's worth investing points into.'

Redoubt.note: +6%/rank block after being crit (30% at 5/5, ~40% uptime for a tank).

Blessing of Kings.note: +10% all stats on yourself (and, not scored, the raid): ~+5% damage/healing, +5% mana, +10% health.

Improved Righteous Fury.note: +16%/rank Righteous Fury threat (60% -> 108% Holy threat at 3/3): ~+6%/rank Holy threat. PvP (2026-09-27): zero, defensive: Righteous Fury threat only: nothing in PvP.

Improved Concentration Aura.note: Pushback aura for the group: healer utility. PvP (2026-09-27): medium, resist: +15% chance for the group to resist silences and interrupts; the pushback half is redundant for a paladin with Spiritual Focus 5/5 (70% plus the aura's 35%). Audit said high; a 15% chance is not Voice of Truth's immunity. Protection tier 4.

Blessing of Sanctuary.note: -10 damage per hit and Holy damage on block: tank mitigation and threat. PvP (2026-09-27): low, defensive: Blessing on yourself: a flat cut to every hit from any source (10 at rank 1, more at higher ranks) plus Holy damage when you block; it takes the blessing slot from Kings or Might. Protection tier 5.

Reckoning.note: 20%/rank extra attack after being crit: tanks get crit by trash; ~+2%/rank white swings tank, +1%/rank leveling. PvP (2026-09-27): medium, burst: Extra attacks after being crit bank as charges and fire together on a slow two-hander: the Reckoning-bomb build noted in builds.json; players crit far more than mobs. Melee, Protection tier 5.

Holy Shield.note: +30% block 10s with 65 Holy damage per block (on demand): +10% effective health, +10% threat.

Improved Blessing of Might.note: +4%/rank Might (+185 AP): +7.4 AP/rank for you (~+0.5%/rank); the raid buff is extra. Raid sim calibration (2026-09-26, wowsims/classic 7779ebb, ret-dps): removing it costs 0.0% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 4.0% on the same scale); raid values scaled x0.12 to match (0.5%). Other modes unchanged. PvP (2026-09-27): zero, burst: Raid buff: +20% Blessing of Might for the group; on yourself only +37 attack power. The audit swaps it for Vindication and Pursuit of Justice in the shockadin.

Improved Seal of the Crusader.note: +5%/rank to Judgement of the Crusader's +140 Holy damage taken: ~+1%/rank Holy damage for you. Raid sim calibration (2026-09-27, wowsims/classic 7779ebb, ret-dps): removing it costs 0.0% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 0.7% on the same scale); raid values scaled x0.00 to match (0.0%). Other modes unchanged.

Vindication.note: Str/Agi debuff: bosses immune; leveling survivability. PvP (2026-09-27): medium, avoid: Melee hits cut the target's Strength and Agility by 15% for 10 s: less attack power, crit and dodge on a warrior, rogue or hunter, for your whole team. Against physical attackers only.

Seal of Command.note: 70% weapon-damage Holy procs: ~+15% two-hander damage over Seal of Righteousness. Not fitted to the Classic simulator: its rotation conditions on this talent, so the removal run measures a broken rotation (raidsim/run.py flags it apl_dependent). PvP (2026-09-27): medium, burst: Judgement of Command does double damage (339-373 at rank 5) on a stunned or incapacitated target: Hammer of Justice then Judgement is the Retribution burst window. The seal's procs are in the damage term (not in the holy-heal model). Melee.

Pursuit of Justice.note: +4%/rank movement: travel. 2026-09-27 audit: run speed is travel, which the fight lab keeps fixed (6 s per kill), so it is no longer fitted: 8% / 15% speed x 6 s travel per ~34 s kill saves 0.44 / 0.78 s -> [0.013, 0.023]; pulls of several mobs travel less per kill -> [0.0035, 0.006]. PvP (2026-09-27): medium, move: +8% run and mount speed, but it does not stack with the 8% Minor Speed boot enchant most PvP players wear: the gain is a freed enchant slot and mount speed. Audit said high; Forever's 15% is high.

Eye for an Eye.note: Spell crit reflect: nothing measurable. PvP (2026-09-27): medium, burst: Casters take 30% of every spell crit they land on you (up to half your health): an 1,800 Shadow Bolt crit sends 540 back. Against casters only.

Sanctity Aura.note: +10% Holy damage for you and the party. Raid sim calibration (2026-09-27, wowsims/classic 7779ebb, ret-dps): removing it costs 0.0% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 1.7% on the same scale); raid values scaled x0.00 to match (1.7%). Other modes unchanged.

Vengeance.note: +3%/rank Physical and Holy damage for 8s after a crit: ~60% uptime at raid crit. Raid sim calibration (2026-09-27, wowsims/classic 7779ebb, ret-dps): removing it costs 12.0% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 12.3% on the same scale); already within tolerance, raid effects split off unchanged (12.4%). Other modes unchanged.

Repentance.note: 6s incapacitate: leveling/dungeon control. 2026-09-27 audit: humanoids only (35-46% of spawns) and any damage wakes it: 0.003 single-target, nothing in AoE pulls (Consecration wakes it). PvP (2026-09-27): high, stun: 6 s incapacitate on a 1 min cooldown against any player (all humanoid; shapeshifted druids aside): peel a melee, lock a healer, drink. Retribution 31 points.

Guardian's Favor.note: BoP/Freedom: healer utility. PvP (2026-09-27): high, escape: Blessing of Freedom 10 -> 16 s (snare and root immunity: leave melee or stay on a kiter) and Blessing of Protection every 3 min instead of 5. Protection tier 2 (5 points).

Improved Hammer of Justice.note: Stun cooldown. 2026-09-27 audit: Hammer of Justice interrupts casting adds: 0.002/rank tank utility. PvP (2026-09-27): high, stun: Hammer of Justice (6 s stun) every 45 s instead of 60 s: the paladin's only stun, and each one doubles Judgement of Command. Protection tier 4 (15 points).

Spiritual Focus.note: 14%/rank pushback resistance on heals: ~+0.7%/rank raid throughput. PvP (2026-09-27): high, resist: 70% chance that Flash of Light and Holy Light lose no cast time when you are hit; with Concentration Aura's 35% they cannot be pushed back at all. Healers and shockadin.

Improved Retribution Aura.note: +25%/rank Retribution Aura damage (parsed): tank threat source.

Toughness.note: +2%/rank armor from items: ~8000 item armor tank -> +800 at 5/5 -> physical damage taken ~-5.8% (armor DR 63.6% -> 65.7%) -> +1.1%/rank effective health. Wowhead classic prot guide: 'Toughness improves your physical damage mitigation'.

Anticipation.note: +2 defense/rank: +0.04% dodge/parry/block/miss and -0.04% crit taken per point -> +1.6% avoidance, -0.4% crit at 5/5 -> ~+3% effective health for a tank (0.6%/rank). Wowhead: 'defense skill, which is the main stat tanks desire'; 'less valuable as your gear improves'.

Benediction.note: Parsed values kept for the other modes; raid values fitted to the community simulator. Raid sim calibration (2026-09-27, wowsims/classic 7779ebb, ret-dps): removing it costs 2.2% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 1.4% on the same scale); already within tolerance, raid effects split off unchanged (1.4%). Other modes unchanged.
